boot_baseline.discrepancy_explanation: This FastAPI/Starlette build (fastapi 0.141.0 / starlette 1.6.0) stores include_router() LAZILY as an opaque _IncludedRouter placeholder instead of flattening child routes into app.routes. Proven by Counter(type(r).__name__ for r in app.routes) == Counter({'_IncludedRouter': 75, 'Route': 4, 'APIRoute': 3, 'APIWebSocketRoute': 1, 'WebSocketRoute': 1}). 75 of the 84 entries are single lazy placeholders, so len(app.routes) counts MOUNT POINTS, not endpoints. The real route surface is len(app.openapi()['paths']) == 738 (OpenAPI forces the routers to expand). CONSEQUENCE FOR THE AUDIT: any finding that quotes len(app.routes) as a route count is wrong; 84 (or 85) is a count of lazy router handles, 738 is the endpoint count.
